results.snippet:
Niger has given Chinese oil companies 45 days to resolve alleged breaches of petroleum agreements, mainly concerning the repatriation of crude oil export revenues.
 The government claims more than $5.2 billion in oil export revenue has not been returned to Niger since crude exports began in April 2024.
